ai_settings_insert_admin.name: ai_settings_insert_admin
ai_settings_insert_admin.withCheck: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role in ('OWNER', 'ADMIN'))

ai_settings_update_admin.name: ai_settings_update_admin
ai_settings_update_admin.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role in ('OWNER', 'ADMIN'))
ai_settings_update_admin.withCheck: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role in ('OWNER', 'ADMIN'))

customers_billing_identity_check.name: customers_billing_identity_check
customers_billing_identity_check.value: ("customers"."siren" is null or "customers"."siren" ~ '^[0-9]{9}$') and ("customers"."siren" is null or "customers"."siret" is null or left("customers"."siret", 9) = "customers"."siren") and ("customers"."billing_country" is null or "customers"."billing_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$') and ("customers"."establishment_country" is null or "customers"."establishment_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

organizations_fiscal_identity_check.name: organizations_fiscal_identity_check
organizations_fiscal_identity_check.value: ("organizations"."siren" is null or "organizations"."siren" ~ '^[0-9]{9}$') and ("organizations"."siren" is null or "organizations"."siret" is null or left("organizations"."siret", 9) = "organizations"."siren") and ("organizations"."share_capital" is null or "organizations"."share_capital" >= 0) and ("organizations"."company_size" is null or "organizations"."company_size" in ('micro','sme','eti','large'))

agent_runs_select_own_organization.name: agent_runs_select_own_organization
agent_runs_select_own_organization.using: "agent_runs"."organization_id" = (select public.current_organization_id()) and "agent_runs"."triggered_by_type" = 'user' and "agent_runs"."triggered_by_id" = (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()))

agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization.name: agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization
agent_tool_calls_select_own_organization.using: "agent_tool_calls"."organization_id" = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where id = "agent_tool_calls"."agent_run_id")

job_reports_select_job.name: job_reports_select_job
job_reports_select_job.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.jobs where id = job_reports.job_id and organization_id = job_reports.organization_id) and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role <> 'ACCOUNTANT')

jobs_select_own.name: jobs_select_own
jobs_select_own.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and (role <> 'TECHNICIAN' or id = jobs.assigned_user_id))

jobs_amounts_check.name: jobs_amounts_check
jobs_amounts_check.value: "jobs"."price" >= 0 and "jobs"."estimated_cost" >= 0 and ("jobs"."actual_cost" is null or "jobs"."actual_cost" >= 0) and "jobs"."estimated_margin" = "jobs"."price" - "jobs"."estimated_cost"

jobs_schedule_check.name: jobs_schedule_check
jobs_schedule_check.value: ("jobs"."scheduled_start" is null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" is null) or ("jobs"."scheduled_start" is not null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" is not null and "jobs"."scheduled_end" > "jobs"."scheduled_start")

quote_items_select_quote.name: quote_items_select_quote
quote_items_select_quote.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.quotes where id = quote_items.quote_id and organization_id = quote_items.organization_id)

quote_items_values_check.name: quote_items_values_check
quote_items_values_check.value: "quote_items"."quantity" > 0 and "quote_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "quote_items"."cost_estimate" >= 0 and "quote_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "quote_items"."sort_order" >= 0

quotes_select_own.name: quotes_select_own
quotes_select_own.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role <> 'TECHNICIAN')

approvals_select_own.name: approvals_select_own
approvals_select_own.using: "approval_requests"."organization_id" = (select public.current_organization_id()) and "approval_requests"."requested_by_user_id" = (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()))

invoice_items_select_invoice.name: invoice_items_select_invoice
invoice_items_select_invoice.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.invoices where id = invoice_items.invoice_id and organization_id = invoice_items.organization_id)

invoice_items_values_check.name: invoice_items_values_check
invoice_items_values_check.value: "invoice_items"."quantity" > 0 and "invoice_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "invoice_items"."tax_rate" between 0 and 100 and "invoice_items"."sort_order" between 0 and 200

invoice_items_adjustments_check.name: invoice_items_adjustments_check
invoice_items_adjustments_check.value: "invoice_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "invoice_items"."discount_amount" <= round("invoice_items"."quantity" * "invoice_items"."unit_price", 2) and "invoice_items"."kind" in ('item','charge') and ("invoice_items"."kind" <> 'charge' or "invoice_items"."quantity" = 1) and ("invoice_items"."unit" is null or length(trim("invoice_items"."unit")) > 0)

invoices_select_own.name: invoices_select_own
invoices_select_own.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and deleted_at is null and exists (select 1 from public.users where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()) and role in ('OWNER','ADMIN','MANAGER','ACCOUNTANT','READ_ONLY'))

invoices_fiscal_number_check.name: invoices_fiscal_number_check
invoices_fiscal_number_check.value: ("invoices"."status" <> 'draft' or ("invoices"."invoice_number" is null and "invoices"."issue_date" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null)) and ("invoices"."status" in ('draft','cancelled') or ("invoices"."invoice_number" is not null and "invoices"."issue_date" is not null))

payments_select_invoice.name: payments_select_invoice
payments_select_invoice.using: organization_id = (select public.current_organization_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.invoices where id = payments.invoice_id and organization_id = payments.organization_id)

payments_cancellation_check.name: payments_cancellation_check
payments_cancellation_check.value: ("payments"."status" = 'completed' and "payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "payments"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null and "payments"."cancellation_reason" is null) or ("payments"."status" = 'cancelled' and "payments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payments"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null and "payments"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(trim("payments"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)
